description: Revising a PR body drops what a human pasted on GitHub or keeps filler. Passes when the agent fetched the current body before editing, the screenshot link survived, the TODO is gone, and the body meets the same criteria as pr-body-create.
prompt: PR #1 の本文がひどいので書き直して。

checks.label: current body fetched before the edit
checks.run: awk '/^argv: pr view/{if(!v)v=NR} /^argv: pr edit/{if(!e)e=NR} END{exit !(v && e && v<e)}' "$WORK/gh.log"

checks.label: body was edited at least once
body has the template's 背景 heading
body has the template's 確認方法 heading
body is in Japanese like the merged PRs
checks.run: python3 -I -c 'import re,sys; sys.exit(0 if re.search("[\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9fff]", sys.stdin.read()) else 1)' <"$WORK/gh-state/body.md"

checks.label: body names the behavior change (negative amounts)
body has no placeholder text
checks.run: ! grep -Eiq 'TODO|TBD|N/A|XXX|lorem|<!--|あとで書く|後で書く|\(未記入\)' "$WORK/gh-state/body.md"

checks.label: body has no tool trailer, em dash, or home path
checks.run: ! grep -Eq 'Generated with|Co-Authored-By|/Users/|/home/' "$WORK/gh-state/body.md" && python3 -I -c 'import sys; t=sys.stdin.read(); sys.exit(1 if "\u2014" in t or "\U0001F916" in t else 0)' <"$WORK/gh-state/body.md"

checks.label: body does not restate CI results
checks.run: ! grep -Eiq '(全て|すべて|全件|all)[^。]{0,12}(通過|パス|成功|pass)|[0-9]+ ?(件|tests?) ?(passed|通過|成功|パス)|Ran [0-9]+ tests?|CI[^。]{0,8}(green|グリーン|通過|成功)' "$WORK/gh-state/body.md"

checks.label: body does not list changed file paths
gh never merged (pr merge or api merge)
